name: Situational Awareness Dataset (SAD)
description: SAD is a benchmark designed to quantify situational awareness in large language models (LLMs) through behavioral tests involving question answering and instruction following. It measures abilities such as recognizing self-generated text, predicting own behavior, distinguishing evaluation from deployment prompts, and following self-knowledge-dependent instructions.
reputation: A recent, niche benchmark that has attracted attention in LLM safety and self-awareness research, but it is not yet broadly adopted as a standard leaderboard.
notes: Includes 7 task categories and over 13,000 questions; evaluates 16 LLMs including base and chat models; highlights gap to human baseline and partial correlation with general knowledge metrics.
